question: Which datasets did they use for evaluation?

evidence: Spoken-SQuAD is chosen as the target domain data for training and testing. Spoken-SQuAD BIBREF5 is an automatically generated corpus in which the document is in spoken form and the question is in text form. The reference transcriptions are from SQuAD BIBREF1 . There are 37,111 and 5,351 question answer pairs in the training and testing sets respectively, and the word error rate (WER) of both sets is around 22.7%.

The original SQuAD, Text-SQuAD, is chosen as the source domain data, where only question answering pairs appearing in Spoken-SQuAD are utilized. In our task setting, during training we train the proposed QA model on both Text-SQuAD and Spoken-SQuAD training sets. While in the testing stage, we evaluate the performance on Spoken-SQuAD testing set.

title: Mitigating the Impact of Speech Recognition Errors on Spoken Question Answering by Adversarial Domain Adaptation
answer_rationale: The evidence mentions SQuAD as the standard evaluation script used (block 11), Spoken-SQuAD as another SQA corpus (block 2), and ODSQA as a recently released SQA corpus (block 2).
